title: Register update on an enumerator configuration
statement: Let $f$ be a function from Boolean words to Boolean words, let $o$ assign a Boolean value to each pair consisting of an index in $\{0,1\}$ and a Boolean word, and suppose that for every Boolean word $x$ and natural number $i$, $o(0,\langle x,\operatorname{bits}(i)\rangle)$ records whether $i$ is less than the length of $f(x)$, while $o(1,\langle x,\operatorname{bits}(i)\rangle)$ is the $i$-th bit of $f(x)$, defaulting to false when that position is absent. For any Boolean words $x,o'$, states $s,s'$ of the specified finite state set, and natural numbers $i,n$, updating register $0$ of the configuration for $x,o',s,i$ to state $s'$, tape content storing the binary expansion of $n$, and head position $0$ yields the configuration for $x,o',s',n$.
